subject.title: [Bug] Agent context window fragmentation during concurrent subagent tool calls

question: Should parent agents receive independently correlated child completions immediately as they finish, or should OpenClaw deliberately buffer all concurrent children until invocation order can be restored?
rationale: Both are coherent orchestration policies, and the report does not establish that completion-order delivery violates an existing OpenClaw or Codex contract.

options.title: Keep event-driven completion
options.body: Preserve immediate identifier-correlated results and require a concrete mis-association reproduction before changing runtime behavior.

options.title: Guarantee invocation order
options.body: Define invocation order as the product contract and accept delayed fast-child results and head-of-line blocking.

recommendation.title: Keep event-driven completion
recommendation.body: Preserve immediate identifier-correlated results and require a concrete mis-association reproduction before changing runtime behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history most strongly connects this owner to the Codex harness boundary and its documented runtime semantics.
